scope.allowed_operation: Compile and disassemble unchanged MAIN only; no prepare, weights, kernel_fn, tensors, device launch or profiler execution.

source_review.device_guards: No GPU allocation; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, availability/device-count false, lazy initialization/device/tensor entry points and prepare/kernel_fn guarded. Final CUDA initialization false required.
source_review.resources_and_receipt: compile-sass CLI fixes600s. Guard called with cpu_4cpu_32gib; receipt kind checked before Sandbox.create. Actual allocation uses gpu=None,cpu=(4,4),memory=(32768,32768),network blocked,600s timeout and idle timeout. Other modes retain default H200 kind and gpu=H200.
source_review.single_compile_bounds: 400s child compile inside560s helper budget; commands use remaining deadline;580s outer worker and600s sandbox. Reviewed run_bounded kills owned process group on timeout/output excess. No retry path.
source_review.binary_evidence: One exact-owned extension, one regular bounded cubin, resource and SASS records containing both BIG symbols, and generated CUDA source-line mapping required. Cubin basename is recorded without assuming an sm90a naming convention.
source_review.artifact_bounds: Allowlisted10files with per-file byte/hash checks,96MiB compressed archive bound, capped2MiB result/96MiB archive reads, fixed paths, rejection of duplicate/nonregular/oversized/missing members. Completion recorded only after verified retrieval; recovery stored separately.
source_review.cleanup: Existing finally termination retained; allocation lock held until termination, failure evidence preserved. Unconfirmed termination blocks later allocation via existing journal policy.

limitations: This records code generation for the pinned diagnostic image/toolchain, not identity with an official evaluator binary. No GPU execution or performance evidence results.
Tool versions, generated sources/build.ninja, cubin and .so are retained; individual installed CUDA/PyTorch header contents are not hashed.
Source mapping presence does not establish a dynamic source-PC attribution or line mapping for every instruction; inspect actual disassembly after completion.
Runtime compiler/tool/import availability and successful extraction remain untested by CPU mocks. Failure remains a terminal bounded diagnostic result, not retry authorization.
Fresh existing guard must still accept live provider usage and cleanup; this review does not override accounting failure.
